metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

metadata.label: False color
metadata.coverage: Six calibrated Cassini IR3, IR1 and UV3 images cover two neighboring close-encounter views. Infrared and ultraviolet are displayed as RGB; this is false color, not natural color or measured albedo. Only registered three-filter overlap contributes; cast shadows remain.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL Saturn satellite orbit and the Archinal rotation frame documented with the PDS shape model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Radial height above an 18 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
